description: If the Philippines isn’t on your travel list yet, let me fix that. 🇵🇭 I showed you the Sirakan Villa before. This time, it’s the Salepan villa. This island resort in Coron, Palawan has been on my bucket list for years, and thank goodness it did not disappoint! I chose it for its proximity to world-class WWII wreck diving sites, with famous limestone lakes and lagoons just a short boat ride away. 🛶 The island also felt very private, with stretches of white sand beach all to ourselves almost the entire trip. Every day we flew our drone. Every day, we got utterly mindblown. 📍Sunlight Ecotourism Island Resort, Coron, Palawan, Philippines #coron #coronpalawan #philippinestiktok #philippinestravel #travelphilippines
